name: Trap Bar Farmer's Walk
steps: Step inside a loaded trap bar, hinge with a flat back, and grip the center of both side handles firmly.
Brace your core, drive through your feet to stand tall, and pack your shoulders back and down.
Walk forward with quick, controlled steps while keeping your torso upright and preventing the bar from swaying.
Come to a controlled stop and hinge down with a flat spine to set the bar back on the floor.
tips: Keep your gaze forward, ribs stacked over your hips, and grip centered so the frame stays level.
Take short, steady strides rather than lunging forward to keep the load from swinging.
